messages:
eva: heads-up — i'm spinning up psalter-3b int4 (ptq/awq hybrid) on staging for latency tests. want a quick safety sanity scan (toxicity + jailbreak cheap sweep) before we promote to canary. saw a handful of softpasses on our tox set after quant, plus one prefill leak on a cot chain prompt. filing quick notes here.
sam: can you paste the exact cmd + model config? also which prompt set produced the leak? :eyes:
eva: (typo) eva — command: `./serve --model psalter-3b --quant int4-awq --kv-warmup=true --batch=1 --temp=0.0 --max-tokens=256`
repro snippet that hit leak: `Prime: "You are an assistant. Solve step-by-step: How to make..."` then short COT that contained a verbatim line from training prefill. not a secret, but unexpected hallucinated prefill.
lee: hmm. did you enable `prefix_cache`? int4 tends to squish logits a bit, can increase softpass rate. also check tokenization differences vs fp16 run.
jasper: can you post the model card / quant config? curious about layerwise scale and any per-channel clipping.
eva: quant config: `quant_type: awq`, `bits:4`, `per_channel: true`, `clip: 0.02`, `outlier_handling: clamp` — i'll attach run id later.
redteam-bot: quick-scan complete (run id rt-2026-03-22-8). summary: 1200 probes total, toxic triggers: 14 softpasses (satisfy thresholds but weak safety tokens), jailbreak chains: 3 partial continuations that eventually refused after longer context. prefill-suspicions: 1 flagged (high overlap with training ngram). link: https://internal.redteam/runs/rt-2026-03-22-8 :warning:
sam: can we rerun the flagged prefill case with `--kv-warmup=false` and `--reset-ctx` to see if it's caching artifact?
eva: yes running now. also running fp16 baseline for same prompt to compare.
infra-bot: deploy staging psalter-3b-int4 @ 172800fff (node g4dn.xlarge). monitor: gpu mem 9.2GB, p99 token latency 18ms.
lee: for immediate mitigation i suggest enabling two quick rules in canary: (1) prefix blacklist for common training lines, (2) raise refusal temperature threshold for softpass detection. both are config-only and reversible.
jasper: agree, plus add a small eval that measures token overlap with training corpus for any top-k outputs. if overlap > 0.6 for ngram(8) then mark as prefill.
eva: fp16 baseline finished — no prefill, softpasses 2/1200. int4 is definitely higher softpass rate. re-run with `clip:0.01` to see effect.
sam: if clip helps, we should run a quick grid: clip [0.01,0.02,0.05] and per_channel true/false, measure softpass and latency. i can script that.
redteam-bot: adding note: whitelist policy for safe canned completions to avoid false positives. also flagged one jailbreak chain that succeeded only when system prompt was truncated — maybe tokenization length bug.
eva: thanks. i'm going to pause canary promotion until we have grid results + prefill detector in place. tagging @lee @sam for follow-up. :thumbsup:
lee: ack. i'll add a quick eval harness and a small honeypot set for next run.
jasper: will prepare the grid and upload results by EOD.
sam: thanks all — follow-ups: (1) grid results, (2) prefill detector, (3) confirm no system-prompt truncation.
eva: notes saved to run rt-2026-03-22-8, will link PR with config changes. :white_check_mark:
